title: Account security
intro: Your password and the devices signed in to the administration. If in doubt (lost computer, sign-in you do not recognise), change your password: all other devices are signed out.
interfaceLangHelp: The language of the menus, buttons and messages in the administration and the editor. It does not change the content of the site: you keep writing in French and English as before.
langFailed: The language could not be changed. Try again.
passwordDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this site: you sign in with Authentik, where your password is changed.
accountIntro: Account: <mono>{email}</mono>. Changing the password signs out all other devices (this session stays open).
newPasswordHelp: At least {min} characters; a phrase of several words is safer and easier to remember.
passwordFailed: The password could not be changed. Try again.
passwordChanged: Password changed. All other devices are signed out.
sessionsHelp: A session expires after {idle} days without use, and {max} days at the latest after it was opened: you then have to sign in again.
revokeTitle: {count, plural, one {Sign out # other session?} other {Sign out # other sessions?}}
revokeBody: The other devices will have to sign in again. This session stays open. If you do not recognise a sign-in, change your password too.
revokeFailed: The other sessions could not be signed out. Try again.
revoked: {count, plural, one {# other session signed out.} other {# other sessions signed out.}}
revokedNone: No other session to sign out.
